text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa and her former homeroom 
teacher tell the Trainer stories of the 
past.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What it means to "live" through racing. 
How knowing that changed Nakayama Festa's 
life forever. This is a cherished story 
from the past, leading up to the moment 
her world began to pulse with life.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her former teacher said, "Hope is what 
keeps people alive." Even if winning the 
Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe was a long shot, 
as long as there was hope, one could live 
life to the very fullest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In response, Nakayama Festa made a 
declaration to her mentor: that after 
living life to the fullest, she would show 
them what it looks like to conquer the 
world.
